denyCommands.reason: Do not bypass git hooks with --no-verify.
Force-push is blocked. Rewrite history only after explicit human approval.
git reset --hard can destroy uncommitted work.
git clean -f can delete untracked files.
sudo is blocked inside coding agents.
chmod 777 is blocked; use least-privilege permissions.
Piping remote scripts into a shell is blocked.

askCommands.reason: Dependency changes require approval. Set ALLOW_DEP_CHANGES=1 only after review.
Creating a pull request requires explicit user confirmation.
Deployment commands require explicit user confirmation.

denyWritePaths.reason: Do not write .env files; environment variables live in helm/values*.yaml.
src/apis is generated by pnpm api:gen. Regenerate instead of hand-editing.
routeTree.gen.ts is generated by TanStack Router.
Compiled Lingui catalogs are generated; run pnpm extract.

askWritePaths.reason: Changing project conventions, tooling or dependencies requires approval.
helm values are the source of truth for environment variables; confirm before editing.
Changing agent guard policy requires approval.
Changing agent wiring or guard hooks requires approval.

denyReadPaths.reason: Reading .env files is blocked to avoid leaking secrets.
